allowed_now: document candidate-only separation from process-local timers

required_before_public_header.decision_required: Keep process-local timers separate from gameplay/server tick callbacks, module tick callbacks, per-frame hooks, and gameplay timers.
Do not add gameplay tick callback public header symbols, capability bits, or callback ABI until every blocker is resolved.
Define tick cadence, frame phase, budget, threading, hitch/backpressure, and shutdown behavior before any gameplay tick API exists.
Define owner-token handle registration, owner-scoped unregister, init-failure cleanup, unload cleanup, and in-flight callback drain before any gameplay tick API exists.
Define any tick payload as copied POD with no UE pointers, raw ProcessEvent params, FString storage, FName/GObjects indices, lookup, mutation, or return override.
Add ABI layout and SDK consumer coverage for the promoted tick callback contract before adding public header symbols.
A v1 release statement must name obelisk.gameplay_tick_callbacks.v1 as post-v1 or explicitly excluded until this surface is promoted.

non_claims: This manifest does not add public header symbols.
This manifest does not promote obelisk.gameplay_tick_callbacks.v1.
This manifest does not make process-local timers sufficient for server tick, UE gameplay tick, module tick, per-frame, or gameplay timer behavior.
This manifest does not authorize runtime tests, server access, marker edits, restarts, Discord notices, commits, tags, or pushes.
